answer: Random peer audit: each epoch, three random peer auditors check each history, staking 10 units each. A fake must show roots like a lotus, not sprout overnight. Like timber, it is load-tested before it bears weight. A failed fake loses its bond; a dishonest auditor loses its stake. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 against 30 per epoch, a 133-epoch payback. Honest agents pay one 40-unit bond, pass easily, keep a violet seal, rewards undiluted.
